description: Chlorophyll-a at 19 CRP stations of segment 2304 (as given by the owner), pooled. Primary target: the event chlorophyll_a >= 10 ug/L on the sample date. Secondary: the concentration (log1p regression). Features are same-visit readings (a nowcast), not a multi-day forecast.
notes: The stations differ: some have no label at or above 10 ug/L since 2014. A model that sees the station one-hot can score those easy negatives, so station_climatology (season and station, nothing else) is the baseline to beat, and the per-station slices matter.
More stations add labels, not independent evidence about one site: stations sampled on the same day share the weather and the season, which is why the bootstrap resamples dates.

baseline_meaning.base_rate: the share of positives among the training labels
baseline_meaning.persistence: the last sample at this station, carried forward (the previous label at the same station on a strictly earlier date; with no earlier label, the training base rate)
baseline_meaning.seasonal_climatology: the mean of the training targets within plus or minus 1 calendar month(s) of the test month, pooled over the task's stations (with fewer than 3 training labels in that window, the mean of all training targets)
baseline_meaning.station_climatology: the mean of the training targets at the same station within plus or minus 1 calendar month(s) of the test month (with fewer than 3 such labels, the pooled seasonal climatology value)
